dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: An incredible organization, dedicated to enriching lives through theater... or at least I'd like to be able to say that.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: At the moment, we're more amateur hobbyists... Or a support group. Oh, if only we had more of a budget...

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Fourmon and Meilhat have been doing all the work lately. And it does seem the two of them alone can already put on a decent performance...
